cases.input: One approved requisition authorizes two seats and two openings.
cases.expect: Normatively, one authorization traces to two openings without merging their identities.

cases.input: One seat is filled while the second remains open.
cases.expect: Normatively, the requisition becomes partially filled and preserves the remaining count.

cases.input: The employer cancels the remaining need after one fill.
cases.expect: Normatively, cancellation preserves the filled employment and historical opening.

cases.input: Calculated vacant capacity automatically creates an asserted opening.
cases.expect: Normatively, the transition is rejected.

cases.input: Approval of the requisition creates employment.
cases.expect: Normatively, the inference is rejected.

cases.input: A public posting is used as the authorization master.
cases.expect: Normatively, the identity merge is rejected.

cases.input: An approved standing requisition has no current opening or campaign.
cases.expect: Normatively, the requisition remains valid without minting an opening.

cases.input: Two fills and one outstanding accepted offer are recorded against a two-seat authorization.
cases.expect: Normatively, the state is rejected unless an attributable cap increase exists.

cases.input: An internal appointment proceeds under a requisition and decision without a public opening.
cases.expect: Normatively, the path remains valid and does not mint an opening.

cases.input: A decision record is reused as the requisition identity.
cases.expect: Normatively, the identity collapse is rejected.

cases.input: An authorized-headcount correction is recorded after its valid date.
cases.expect: Normatively, valid and recorded time remain distinct and history is preserved.

cases.input: One opening is published to two channels and one posting is withdrawn.
cases.expect: Normatively, postings retain distinct local identity and times while opening and requisition remain unchanged.

cases.input: A rejection has no WM-REC-010 selection decision.
cases.expect: Normatively, status alone cannot carry the outcome and the state is non-conformant.

cases.input: A non-binding recommendation is recorded without a decision.
cases.expect: Normatively, the candidacy does not advance to selected.

cases.input: An accepted offer is asked to create Contract or Assignment.
cases.expect: Normatively, creation is outside EM-PEO-04 and is refused.

cases.input: Every identifier token is linted against bases and source facts.
cases.expect: Normatively, no identifier is dangling.

cases.input: A derived vacancy projection is persisted and cited by an opening.
cases.expect: Normatively, persistence and citation are forbidden.

cases.input: A draft requests three seats and is treated as authorizing them.
cases.expect: Normatively, no seat authority exists before an approval-backed cap.

cases.input: The cap changes from two to three without actor or decision.
cases.expect: Normatively, the change is non-conformant.

cases.input: Cap two has one non-cancelled fill.
cases.expect: Normatively, consumed is one, remaining is one and status is partially-filled.

cases.input: An accepted offer converts to employment.
cases.expect: Normatively, consumed seats remain one and are not double-counted.

cases.input: Two accepted offers target different openings of a one-seat requisition.
cases.expect: Normatively, the requisition-level cap detects the excess.

cases.input: Three versions exist and the middle is queried.
cases.expect: Normatively, predecessor and successor are resolvable.

cases.input: A backdated correction has no recorder.
cases.expect: Normatively, it is non-conformant.

cases.input: Status is approved without approvalDecisionRefs.
cases.expect: Normatively, it is non-conformant.

cases.input: Status is funded with budgetRef alone.
cases.expect: Normatively, fundingAuthorityRef is required.

cases.input: A closed requisition returns to open.
cases.expect: Normatively, a successor requisition is required.

cases.input: Two closed candidacies have hired and not-selected outcomes.
cases.expect: Normatively, outcomes remain distinguishable without consulting Employment.

cases.input: Candidacy names R while R's derived index omits it.
cases.expect: Normatively, the index is wrong and the child reference remains authoritative.

cases.input: A decision cites a disposed CV.
cases.expect: Normatively, a tombstone resolves without restoring content.

cases.input: All four recruiting-effort scope fields are absent.
cases.expect: Normatively, structural validation rejects it.
